## Functions

### `projectRealmForgeConstructionArticulationHits(snapshot, { assemblyResourceId = null, viewportRenderModel = null, resolveProduct = getConstructionStockProduct, resolveJointProfile = getConstructionJointProfile, } = {})`

Resolve selectable articulation hit targets without building construction pieces, colliders, broadphase pairs, islands, body descriptors, or PhysX. Phase 6 calls this once for the exact immutable document/viewport head.
